# AltrexTech

> Altrex Digital Platforms Pvt Ltd provides digital platforms for connected industrial operations, bringing Industrial IoT, SCADA, GIS, asset management, fleet tracking, video analytics, energy management, and analytics together.

## Website
- https://www.altrextech.com/

## Digital Platform for Connected Operations
Altrex presents a unified digital platform for industrial operations that transforms field data into real-time intelligence through Industrial IoT, SCADA, GIS, Asset Management, Fleet Tracking, and Analytics.

### Platform Capabilities
- Web SCADA — real-time monitoring and control.
- Industrial IoT — connect devices and field assets.
- GIS & Asset Management — location intelligence and asset visibility.
- Fleet Management — vehicle tracking and operational optimization.
- Video Analytics — AI-powered surveillance and monitoring.
- Energy Management — monitor and optimize energy consumption.

### Platform Features
- Dashboards
- GIS Mapping
- Alarm Management
- Historian
- Mobile Access
- Open APIs
- User Management
- Reports

## Enterprise Platform Characteristics
- Enterprise security: IEC-62443-aligned architecture, multi-factor authentication, role-based access control, and audit trails.
- Scalability: supports deployments ranging from a single site to multiple sites and large numbers of assets.
- Hybrid infrastructure: on-premise, cloud, and edge-ready deployment options.
- Reliability: redundant infrastructure, intelligent failover, hot standby, and maintenance/upgrades described as zero-planned-downtime.
- 24×7 monitoring.

## Connected Operations Architecture
### Devices
PLCs, RTUs, sensors, rectifiers, HMIs, SCADA, DCS, and IoT devices.

### Connectivity
MQTT, OPC-UA, MODBUS, Ethernet, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, REST API, SQL/NoSQL.

### Platform
Web SCADA, visualization, alerting, and asset management.

### Hosting
On-premise server, private cloud, and public cloud.

### Enterprise Services
SAP, ERP, and CRM integrations.

## Services
- SaaS Platform Services — subscription access to platform capabilities; multi-tenant architecture with role-based access, elastic scaling, and continuous updates.
- Turnkey Project Implementation — requirements scoping, solution architecture, on-site deployment, commissioning, handover, and documentation.
- Managed Services & AMC — preventive maintenance, incident response, and annual maintenance contracts with SLA guarantees.
- System Integration Services — API and middleware connectivity, legacy and third-party integrations, and unified data flow.
- Industrial IoT & Edge Integration — field-device and PLC connectivity, edge processing with cloud synchronization, and protocol translation.
- CCTV & Video Analytics Services — CCTV network design and installation, AI-based detection, centralized video management, and archival.
- Cloud & Infrastructure Services — cloud architecture, migration, hybrid/on-prem infrastructure, monitoring, and capacity planning.
- GIS & Asset Digitization — GPS-based asset mapping, GIS layers, spatial data modeling, and digital asset registries.
- Training & Consulting — onboarding, hands-on training, process/workflow consulting, and technical-team training programs.

## Industries Served
### City Gas Distribution
Web SCADA, Industrial IoT Platform, GIS-based network management, CNG station monitoring, and cascade management system.

### Oil & Gas
Web SCADA and real-time monitoring, Industrial IoT and edge integration, pipeline monitoring and leak detection, GIS-based asset management, and tank farm management.

### Water & Wastewater
Web SCADA and real-time monitoring, smart water metering (AMR/AMI), Industrial IoT and remote telemetry, leak detection and NRW management, and GIS-based utility asset management.

### Power & Utilities
Web SCADA and real-time grid monitoring, smart metering (AMR/AMI), energy management system (EMS), smart-grid monitoring, and renewable-energy monitoring.

### Renewable Energy
Renewable-energy SCADA platform, solar plant monitoring, wind farm monitoring, BESS monitoring and optimization, and energy management system (EMS).

### Manufacturing & Industrial Automation
Industrial SCADA and real-time monitoring, OEE monitoring, production monitoring, predictive maintenance, and energy management system (EMS).

### Logistics & Transportation
GPS vehicle tracking system (VTS), fuel monitoring and analytics, route optimization and trip management, video telematics and driver safety, and fleet management system.

### Smart Cities
Integrated Command & Control Center (ICCC), smart utility management, smart metering (AMR/AMI), Intelligent Transportation System (ITS), and GIS-based smart-city platform.

### Infrastructure & Utilities
Infrastructure SCADA and real-time monitoring, utility management system, smart metering (AMR/AMI), energy management system (EMS), and GIS-based infrastructure asset management.

## Operational Challenges Addressed
The website identifies challenges including manual meter reading and data entry, delayed fault detection, and lack of unified asset visibility.

## Contact / Next Step
The website invites visitors to explore solutions or schedule a demo to modernize operations, connect assets, visualize operations, and support data-informed decisions.

## Frequently Asked Questions
The homepage lists these FAQ topics:
- How scalable is the infrastructure?
- Do you support MQTT and WebSocket?
- Is the platform enterprise ready?
- Can I integrate with existing systems?

## Brand Summary
Altrex is presented as a unified industrial digital platform for managing connected assets, operations, alarms, analytics, and field infrastructure, with capabilities covering IIoT connectivity, SCADA, GIS, digital twins, AI analytics, reporting, and enterprise integration.
